about: Heroes of the Storm's effect models (the .m3 files under Assets/Effects in its data, default skins only), described in our own words for StarCraft II map makers: each look was written by an agent from frames of the effect loaded into StarCraft II and filmed there, attached to a Marine on plain ground (sc2-adjutant's effect tour), and says what it shows, how big it is next to the Marine, whether it follows a moving host and whether anything lingers after it is destroyed. Each model's path is the key that finds it; nothing else here is extracted from either game, and no pictures ship or are linked.

Assets/Effects/Storm_Building_KingsCrest.look: Grey stone chunks and slabs burst outward in a ring around the host, each throwing up a pale grey dust puff, over an area about three to four Marines wide. The dust clears and the chunks lie on the ground. Nothing is left once it is destroyed.
A handful of dark grey rock chunks lie scattered in a loose ring about three Marines wide, with no fire or dust to speak of. A few small chunks are still near the spot after it is destroyed.
problems: the moving still shows no chunks, so whether it follows is unclear
